measured_retained_work.clean_reproduction_execution_note: Resumable deterministic chunks; after a parent timeout left one Q018 parent-timing field incomplete, that case was intentionally refreshed. Its deterministic scientific payload was unchanged and no scientific case was removed.

campaign_budget_assessment.note: The campaign and clean reproduction are bounded finite CPU work. Literature reading and manuscript authorship are not scientific experiment executions and are not counted as worker CPU.

reproduction_boundary: Clean-extraction reproduction by the same executor; not independent human validation.
